intro:
Everything here can be bought by walking into a shop in Taichung. Nothing needs an online order. Tick items off as you buy them: the ticks are remembered on this phone or computer.

How sure are the prices? I could not open the shops’ own websites from here. ≈ marks a price read from a search listing of the shop’s own page. ~ marks my estimate of a normal shop price. Treat the total as right to within about a fifth, and check the shelf.

That is about __TOTAL__ in all, of which about NT$9,200 is the camp T-shirts and NT$5,800 the two cornhole sets. All six parts are now priced. If Bambi cannot lend a projector for the hall, a wet Friday film needs a portable projector, which is better borrowed than bought.

Ask Dave and James before you buy

Bambi may already have, or lend: kayaks, paddles, life jackets and a throw line at the dock, firewood, a fire bucket and an extinguisher at the fire circle, the screen, projector and sound, including in the hall on a wet night, two tea urns and hot water for warm drinks, snacks for the mid-morning breaks, a table for table tennis, extension leads, a trolley for moving the boxes, a ladder for the egg drops, a dry, lockable place to store the kit.
storage:
Storage and transport

How much there is: about 12 storage bins of 65 litres, four big carrier bags of soft things (throws, ponchos, bibs, T-shirts), and a few loose items. Together that is roughly 2 to 2.5 cubic metres and about 250 kg.

At home or at camp the bins stack three high in four stacks, on about one square metre of floor. Allow a second square metre along a wall for the loose items: the bundle of 30 poles (2 m long), the cornhole boards (120 × 60 cm), six hula hoops, the two mini goals, the nested buckets and the water containers.

Getting it there: it is too much for a car boot. Ask the coach company for the size of the luggage hold, because it also has to take 40 people’s bags. If the hold is under about 7 cubic metres, send the kit separately in a small van or a seven-seat car with the seats folded, on the Wednesday or early on Thursday, and ask Dave and James for a dry, lockable place near our vans.

Packing plan: one bin per activity

Number each bin on the lid and two sides and tape a contents card inside the lid. Each evening two counselors restock and set out the next morning’s bins.
